description: The MAUPP and REACT projects publish a street-block land-use classification for Dakar, Senegal. Blocks extracted from OpenStreetMap carry residential, non-residential, agricultural, vegetation and bare-soil classes, including planned and deprived residential categories. The Shapefile attribute table supplies class probabilities, the two highest-ranked classes, their probability difference and built-up percentages. Separate style files accompany the geometries. Zenodo assigns the MIT licence, allowing free reuse. These inputs for urban-scale simulations can allocate service demand or compare infrastructure access across neighbourhood types. Labels are modelled classifications and the uncertainty field should be retained; a deprived-area label is not a direct household socioeconomic observation. Geometry and attribute completeness were not tested. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Dakar Land Use Map At Street Block Level
notes: G4-0426; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
